summary: --- name: systematic-debugging description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes --- # Systematic Debugging ## Overview Random fixes waste time and create new bugs. Quick patches mask underlying issues. **Core principle:** ALWAYS find root cause before attempting fixes. Symptom fixes are failure. **Violating the letter of this process is violating the spirit of debugging.** ## The Iron Law
